scenes: Do crops need cool nights too?
They do. On warm nights, plants keep using up the energy they made by day. | In field trials in the Philippines, rice yields fell about ten per cent for every degree of warmer nights.
And in many places, nights are warming faster than days. | Heat-tolerant varieties and better timing buy farmers time.
Protect the night, protect the harvest.
